context.content: first of all your ability bar is a complete mess and not good DPS, i would recommend searching on youtube for "junesong" and use his ability bar/dps guide. Alternativly you can also copy and paste from the wiki they also have optimal ability bar set ups, without explanation though. Impact should not on your ability bar if the target can not be stunned, bad DPS. I dont know what your weapon is but you are using Hybrid armor, there is no reason to bring more than 1 combat style. Use the best power armor you can afford and fill the slots you are missing. I would suggest greg, as he is the strongest. Linza last because she has a special quake ability that can heal you for 3000 life points with resonance. Nomads attacks all suck except his special which can be dodged with a shield+defensive ability switch. For that reason i also suggest a 1 handed weapon so you can go from 2hander to mainhand+shield. You need more ability bars on your screen and more hotkeys to properly switch and use defensive abilities. Doing that stuff manually is too slow (if your gear window is covering those abilities disregard this part)
